integrity: All finite checks described were executed against the standalone Python checker; the infinite theorem follows from the algebraic move-by-move identity and independent combinatorial enumeration proof. Bibliographic searches cannot guarantee unique novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one vacancy on \(K_{a,b}\) for a,b>=2; exact potential for all finite type counts; equilibrium enumerator only for two types. No extension to general bipartite graphs or additional vacancies is established. No independent validation.
title: Exact potential and equilibrium census for one-vacancy diversity jumps on complete bipartite graphs
